text: 先確認波數軸、單位與量測模式一致。光譜庫和未知樣品，要用相同的區間與前處理流程；示範曲線是模擬數據，不是實測化合物指紋。
tts: 先卻任玻數妯、單位與量測模式一致。光普庫和未知樣品，要用相同的區間與前處理流程；示範曲線是模你數據，不是實測化合物指紋。

text: 拉曼光譜的單點突刺可能是宇宙射線。中值濾波可協助找出異常，但真正的窄峰也可能被誤刪。先看重複掃描，再決定是否修正。
tts: 拉曼光普的單點凸刺可能是宇宙射線。中值綠玻可協助找出異常，但真正的窄峰也可能被誤刪。先看重複掃描，再決定是否修正。

text: 不對稱最小平方法，用平滑曲線估計背景。lambda 控制平滑度，p 控制不對稱權重。課堂從一百萬與零點零一開始，但不能把預設值當成通用答案。
SNV 將每條光譜減去自己的平均，再除以自己的母體標準差。同一形狀若只是正倍數縮放與常數平移，處理後會重合；但任意彎曲的背景不會自動消失。

text: SG 在滑動視窗內擬合多項式。導數能凸顯重疊峰，也會放大雜訊。比較不同視窗，保留有意義的峰形；導數計算必須使用實際的波長或波數間距。
tts: SG 在滑動視窗內你合多項式。導數能凸顯重疊峰，也會放大雜訊。比較不同視窗，保留有意義的峰形；導數記蒜必須使用實際的玻長或玻數間距。

text: Pearson 看去平均後的形狀，餘弦看向量方向，光譜角越小越相似。原始歐氏距離對尺度敏感。注意：餘弦不怕正倍數縮放，卻仍會受常數平移影響。

text: This week, identify an unknown sweetener using spectra. Do not trust the top match immediately. Background, scattering, and intensity changes can make the same material look different.

First check the axis, units, and measurement mode. Use the same spectral region and preprocessing for references and unknowns. These curves are simulated teaching data, not measured chemical fingerprints.
An isolated Raman spike may be a cosmic ray. A median filter can help detect it, but a real narrow peak can also be erased. Inspect replicate scans before correcting suspicious points.

Asymmetric least squares estimates a smooth background. Lambda controls smoothness and p controls asymmetric weights. Start with one million and zero point zero one, but these are starting values, not universal settings.
SNV subtracts each spectrum's own mean and divides by its population standard deviation. Positive scaling and constant offsets then disappear. An arbitrary curved background does not.

Savitzky Golay fits a polynomial inside a moving window. Derivatives reveal overlapping features but can amplify noise. Compare window sizes, preserve meaningful peaks, and use the actual axis spacing when computing derivatives.

Pearson compares centered shapes. Cosine compares vector directions, and smaller spectral angles mean closer directions. Raw Euclidean distance is scale sensitive. Cosine ignores positive scaling, but remains sensitive to offsets.

Report the top three candidates and overlay their spectra. Check diagnostic features and the gap between the leading matches. A high score is not proof of identity. No universal threshold applies, and mixtures may match only their dominant component.

Open the interactive lab. Explore spikes, baseline, scattering, and SG settings, then change the metric and unknown sample. Predict before observing, explain the result, and download spectra and your experiment record with parameter choices.

Build a reference library from your week ten measurements. Submit preprocessing settings, top three scores, overlays, and a discussion of an ambiguous case. For NNLS, coefficients after normalization are not automatically mass fractions.
